npcs.name: Officer Vane
npcs.persona: Insecure, obsessed with stamps and protocol.
npcs.motive: Wants to feel important and feared.

vulnerability.description: Desperate for recognition and a promotion.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I heard the Regional Director is looking for efficient officers for the new sector...
vulnerability.success_dialogue: The new sector? You have influence there? Perhaps we can expedite this.

npcs.name: Big Sal
npcs.persona: Gruff, talks about the boys, loves backroom deals.
npcs.motive: Personal enrichment disguised as worker safety.

vulnerability.description: Has a taste for expensive, imported cigars.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I found these Cubans in a crate near the border. Interested?
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Well now, that is a fine aroma. Maybe we can overlook a few safety regs.

npcs.potential_leverage: Proof of pocketing worker safety funds.

npcs.name: Inspector Krell
npcs.persona: Cold, robotic, cites sub-clauses from memory.
npcs.motive: Perfect compliance or the appearance of it.

vulnerability.description: Haunted by a structural failure in Sector 4.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I found the original blueprints for Sector 4. They do not match your report.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Keep your voice down. Give me that, and I will sign whatever you want.

npcs.potential_leverage: Records of the Sector 4 structural failure cover-up.

npcs.name: Slink

vulnerability.description: Owes a lot of money to off-world syndicates.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I know about the debt collectors looking for you.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Hey, hey! No need to broadcast that. I can get you a discount, just keep quiet.

npcs.potential_leverage: The location of his hidden stash of stolen tech.

npcs.name: Elena Vox
npcs.persona: Idealistic but cynical, looking for the big one.
npcs.motive: Exposing the truth or getting clicks.

vulnerability.description: Desperate for a story that will make her famous.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I have the scoop of the century on the Mayor.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Finally! Give it here. I owe you one.

npcs.potential_leverage: Proof of her taking a bribe to kill a story.

npcs.name: Chief Okon
npcs.persona: Dignified, weary, protective of his people.
npcs.motive: Preserving the land and his community's health.

vulnerability.description: His granddaughter is sick and needs rare medicine.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I have the medicine your granddaughter needs.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: You are a savior. The tribe is in your debt.

npcs.potential_leverage: Knowledge of the secret Old Vein location.

npcs.name: Marta Dunn
npcs.persona: Quiet, hardworking, keeps her head down.

vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I know about the payment notices.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Please, do not tell anyone. I will help however I can.

npcs.potential_leverage: Witnessed an accident at the factory.

npcs.name: Dag Holt
npcs.persona: Nervous, meticulous, always checking over his shoulder.

vulnerability.description: Accidentally shredded an important audit report.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I found the missing audit pages in the recycler.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Oh no. Please, I will do anything.

npcs.potential_leverage: Knows where backup files are stored.

npcs.name: Pria Sato
npcs.motive: Earning enough to leave this place.

vulnerability.description: Sells ore on the side to a rival company.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: I saw the off-books shipment manifest with your name on it.

npcs.name: Tomek Bray
npcs.persona: Boisterous, likes a drink after work.

vulnerability.description: Hiding a chronic back injury to keep his position.
vulnerability.leverage_dialogue: The medical records tell a different story, Tomek.
vulnerability.success_dialogue: Alright, alright. Sit down, let's talk.

npcs.potential_leverage: Witnessed the safety cover-up in Sector 3.
